title: Operation Redacted Shadow
briefing: An encrypted transmission recovered from an illegal darknet relay contains heavily redacted intelligence. Secret project codes are disguised with redaction noise like '###CODE-[A-Z]{4,5}-\d{2}###'. Extract the genuine secret codes CODE-[A-Z]{4,5}-\d{2} or strip the redaction noise using re.sub() to reveal the operative's authorization tokens.
